title: Positive Airway Pressure Equipment

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The request includes a documented sleep-related diagnosis.
- The record references an appropriate diagnostic sleep evaluation.
- The requested equipment and settings are supported by a treating-provider order.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Sleep-study type, date and summarized results
- Treating-provider diagnosis
- Equipment order and requested settings
- Relevant symptoms and comorbidities
- Usage or adherence information for continued coverage

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- An equipment order alone does not establish all coverage requirements.
- Replacement equipment may require previous-device information.
- Benefit coverage must be checked separately.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
